{{Quote|So, you in this for the long haul? Or is the Republic going to cut and run as soon as the things get tough?|Taya Rinn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Taya Rinn''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. From the [[Moraine Outpost]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] she tasked a Republic citizen with recovering sensitive resistance data that was stolen when the Imperials attacked a nearby base.
